title: Baba Ghanoush
description: Baba Ghanoush is a traditional Arabic smoky eggplant dip made with roasted eggplants, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil. It has a creamy yet slightly chunky texture and a rich, smoky flavor, commonly served as part of a mezze platter with warm pita bread.

ingredients.title: Ingredients (Serves 4-6)
items: 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for drizzling
Optional garnish: pomegranate seeds, chopped parsley, smoked paprika

instruction.title: Instructions
steps:
1. Roast the Eggplants:
• Preheat your oven to 220°C (425°F) or prepare a grill.
• Prick the eggplants with a fork to prevent bursting.
• Roast for 30–40 minutes, turning occasionally, until the skin is charred and the flesh is soft.
• Let cool slightly, then peel off the skin carefully.
• Chef Tip: For authentic smoky flavor, lightly char over an open flame before peeling.

2. Prepare the Eggplant Purée:
• Scoop the flesh into a mixing bowl.
• Mash using a fork or food processor until smooth but slightly textured.

3. Season:
• Add tahini, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, and salt.
• Mix gently until combined.
• Adjust balance: more lemon for acidity, more tahini for creaminess.

4. Plate and Garnish:
• Spoon into a shallow serving dish.
• Drizzle with olive oil.
• Sprinkle with parsley, pomegranate seeds, or smoked paprika.

5. Serve:
• Serve chilled or at room temperature with warm pita bread or mezze platter.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Include as part of a mezze platter
Pair with grilled meats or kebabs
Use as a dip for vegetables or crackers

chefTips: Smokiness is key: grilling eggplants gives the most authentic flavor.
Keep texture slightly chunky for a more traditional feel.
Use fresh, high-quality tahini for best results.
A swirl of olive oil and colorful garnish improves presentation and flavor balance.
